title: 第7章 六神珠第8章 魔修
content_zh:
杨威可以断定这一切都是魔修干的而非野兽，他去过红林村外的荒野那里虽然有狼群却绝对没有如此大规模
一晚上便将二十多人吃的只剩骨头，不是正常野兽能干得出的
他不由得便又想起那些个小鬼啃食尸体的画面，同样也是将血肉全部吃光，两者简直如出一辙
仅凭凡人官府去探案是不会有结果的，就如那人说的稀里糊涂当天下午就断案是野兽所为，后续估计也不会有什么新进展
杨威没把希望放在这些凡人身上，可以肯定的是他前脚刚走没几天对方就来了，定然与李瘸子和那邪修有关
他现在要考虑的是对方会不会来找自己？又会以何种方式追踪
由于听到有人说起红林村的事情，翠翠吃的格外的慢竖起耳朵听着
杨威则独自上楼进了客房中，他拿出那颗乌黑圆珠放在桌上细细观察
他检查过自己和翠翠身上都没有神魂印记，唯一可能定位的也只有这件东西了
从外观看此物通体光亮如同一颗黑珍珠除此之外既没有灵力外溢也没有任何招人注意的地方
若非杨威之前试过无法破坏，他都不知道这是一件修士用的法宝
随后检查封印之时杨威惊奇发现自己打在上面的几道隔绝术法竟然只剩一道了
按理说自然消除不会如此快的除非宝物上有猫腻
想到此处杨威鼓动法力神识注入珠子，果然在其中发现一道微弱的意念
应是前主人留下的，杨威没有犹豫直接将之抹去
转而又咬破指尖挤出一丝精血落在珠子上，一阵微弱乌光亮起这件宝物便认主被他掌控了
只见他打出一道法诀，珠子微微震颤随后竟蹦出六只乌黑小鬼来
他们都是胎毛稀疏的婴儿，趴在地上爬行着，肚脐上连接着一根似有若无的脐带一直延伸到珠子里
杨威记得这是那女邪修所用的小鬼，战斗力并不强被他几下便斩灭了，原来是这珠子召唤出来的
然而在后续使用更为熟悉此宝功能后杨威却是笑了，他惊奇发现这件宝物本就不是用来直接战斗的

“去！
只见他一声令下召唤出的小鬼们四散爬走，不一会儿它们便回来了，并且一个个头上要么顶着一锭银子要么则咬着一件珠宝
没错这件宝物有着召唤小鬼寻宝的功能，它们能够自主的去找周围有价值的东西
“宝物”
的范畴不止物品还包括一切天地灵物，这其中当然也包括人身上的
这也就解释的通为何翠翠那晚肩头上有只小鬼了，显然是发现了她身怀双灵根
那女邪修估摸下的命令便是找寻有资质的肉身方便她夺舍
想必其得到这件宝物的时间也不长，否则也不会身上除了这件宝物外就没有其他东西了
掌控着珠子杨威的视野也变得更为广阔了，只要想他就能看到几只小鬼的视野，意念一动还可分出控制小鬼行动
而且只要本体珠子不被破坏这六只小鬼就不死不灭的，运转起来也几乎不损耗自身法力
“嗯，不错果然是件好宝贝，以后你就叫六神珠了”
杨威越看越是喜欢，当即给这宝物取了个名
纵然重生几世他也没拥有过几件这般有趣的宝物，自己这次真是捡到宝了
之前那女邪修简直暴殄天物啊，竟然直接用六神珠来战斗
在杨威看来更好的用法实在太多了，完全可以控制小鬼带着天雷子或是定身符打敌人个措手不及
如此看来六神珠简直就是老六用来偷鸡摸狗的神器
content_en:
Yang Wei could conclude that all this was done by demon cultivators rather than wild beasts. He had been to the wilderness outside Honglin Village. Although there were wolves there, they were definitely not on such a large scale.
To eat more than twenty people down to their bones in one night is not something a normal beast can do.
He couldn't help but think of those scenes of little ghosts eating corpses. They also ate up all the flesh and blood. The two were exactly the same.
Merely relying on mortal officials to investigate the case will not lead to any results. Just as the man said in a daze and concluded that the case was the work of wild animals that afternoon, there will probably be no new progress in the future.
Yang Wei didn't put his hope in these mortals. What is certain is that the other party came just a few days after he left. It must be related to Li Laizi and the evil cultivator.
What he has to consider now is whether the other party will come to him? How will it be tracked?
Because she heard someone talking about things in Honglin Village, Cuicui ate extra slowly and pricked up her ears to listen.
Yang Wei went upstairs alone and entered the guest room. He took out the black ball and placed it on the table to observe carefully.
He checked that neither he nor Cuicui had soul marks, and the only thing that could be located was this one.
From the outside, this object is as bright as a black pearl. Other than that, it has no spiritual power or anything to attract attention.
If Yang Wei hadn't tried it before and couldn't destroy it, he wouldn't have known it was a magic weapon used by monks.
Later, when he checked the seal, Yang Wei was surprised to find that only one of the isolation spells he had cast on it was left.
It stands to reason that natural elimination will not be so fast unless there is something fishy on the treasure.
Thinking of this, Yang Wei encouraged his magic power and consciousness to inject into the beads, and sure enough he found a weak thought in them.
It should have been left by the previous owner, so Yang Wei directly erased it without hesitation.
Then he bit his fingertips and squeezed out a trace of blood and fell on the bead. A faint black light lit up, and the treasure recognized its owner and was under his control.
I saw him cast a spell, the beads trembled slightly, and then six black devils popped out.
They are all babies with sparse lanugo, crawling on the ground, with a seemingly invisible umbilical cord connected to their navel extending into the beads.
Yang Wei remembered that this was the imp used by the female evil cultivator. It was not very powerful and was killed by him in a few blows. It turned out that it was summoned by this bead.
However, Yang Wei smiled after he became more familiar with the functions of this treasure through subsequent use. He was surprised to find that this treasure was not used for direct combat.
"Go!
I saw the little ghosts summoned by him crawling away in all directions. After a while, they came back, and each of them either had a silver ingot on their head or a piece of jewelry in their teeth.
Yes, this treasure has the function of summoning ghosts to hunt for treasure. They can independently search for valuable things around them.
"treasure"
Its scope includes not only objects but also all spiritual objects in heaven and earth, which of course also includes human beings.
This also explains why Cuicui had a little ghost on her shoulder that night. Apparently, he discovered that she had two spiritual roots.
The evil cultivator's order was probably to find a qualified body so that she could seize it.
Presumably he has not obtained this treasure for a long time, otherwise he would not have anything else except this treasure.
The vision of Yang Wei who controls the beads has also become wider. He can see the vision of several imps as long as he thinks about it, and can also control the actions of the imps with a single thought.
Moreover, as long as the main body beads are not destroyed, these six little devils are immortal, and their operation hardly consumes their own mana.
"Well, yes, it is indeed a good treasure. From now on, you will be called Liushenzhu."
The more Yang Wei looked at it, the more he liked it, and he immediately gave the treasure a name.
Even though he has been reborn for several lifetimes, he has never owned such interesting treasures. He really found a treasure this time.
The evil female cultivator before was so wasteful that she even used the Six God Pearls to fight.
In Yang Wei's opinion, there are too many better ways to use it. He can completely control the kid to bring Tianleizi or amulet to catch the enemy by surprise.
From this point of view, Liushenzhu is simplyIt's an artifact used by Lao Liu to steal chickens and dogs.
